title: Mental Health Screening Transport
summary: Taking a person to a screening service.

steps.text: Make the scene safe and slow things down; request a crisis team if available
Decide whether there are reasonable grounds for screening
Pat down for weapons before transport
Transport to the designated screening service; brief the screener
Document observations, statements and behavior that supported the decision

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
